title: fix(plugin-detail,app-shell,components): record page round 2 — related OFF draws no column or rail, one segmented panel control in the header row, three columns in a 1440 window with the sidebar
body:
Fixes #27055
Fixes #27241

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Round 2 of the record page v3 (epic #26676), on `main` after #27310: the three rulings of #27241, the #27069 fence half of #27055, and a standing 「恢复默认顺序」 entry. Maintainer, 2026-10-28, verbatim: 「是：三栏阈值改成 1440 窗口（含侧栏）即三栏；开关改进头部动作行，关联 OFF 就没有栏」.

## What changes

**A1 — the related switch decides whether the column exists.** `recordPageArrangementFor` sets `relatedRail` to `switches.related && !columns.includes('related')`, and `RecordPageColumns` draws the related column only when the arrangement places it. Related OFF: no related column and no rail toggle, in both column tiers. Related ON with no room (two-column tier): the rail toggle, which opens the column. With both switches off the page is the details column alone.

**A2 — one segmented control at the end of the header's action row.** `PanelToggles` (`@object-ui/components`) is now one segmented control, an icon and a label per segment (Timeline with the activity glyph, Related column with the right-panel glyph). The console's record view hands it to `page:header` through a new host slot, `PageHeaderTrailingContext`. `PageHeaderActions` draws it as the last segment of its `role=toolbar` row, after `⋯`, behind a vertical hairline. It is drawn in both column tiers, and not in the tabbed tier or in the drawer. The toolbar gained `max-w-full`, so on a narrow header the segment wraps onto its own line, right-aligned, instead of running past the page (measured at a 1024 px window; see screenshot 08). The crumb row keeps only the ways back (origin link, 「Collapse to drawer」) and has no child without one, so `empty:hidden` removes it. Tooltip keycaps and `aria-keyshortcuts` are unchanged. The chord matcher accepts `code` `Period` / `Comma`, or `key` `.` / `>` and `,` / `<`.

**A3 — thresholds.** Measured on the console from this branch (HotCRM contact, sidebar expanded): the sidebar is 255 px plus its 1 px border, and `[data-record-page-root]` is 1184 px in a 1440 window, 1024 px in 1280 and 768 px in 1024. The constants are `1440 − 256 − 64 = 1120` and `1024 − 256 − 8 = 760`, with the derivation in their docblock. The #26758 tier pins move to 1120 / 760, plus a pin on the three windows the thresholds serve. `e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` opens the tab strip, so its viewport moves from 1200 to 1000, which keeps the record view under the new two-column floor.

**B — the #27069 fence half.**
- *Default order.* The premise was half stale. `deriveRelatedLists` already orders by the object's `relatedLists` (`resolveRelatedListOrder`, landed with #27215/#27303), and `synthParts` keeps that order. Only the fence comment said otherwise. The comment is replaced, and a mounted pin (`RecordDetailView.relatedListsOrder-27241`) holds the card order with and without `relatedLists`.
- *Body-table placement.* `bodyTablePlacement` reads the field groups. A body table whose relationship a group's `relatedList` names (child object name, or `object.field`) is drawn at that group's position among `fieldGroups`. Other body tables keep the "after the first section" rule. The one reading of an entry, `relatedListEntryNames`, moved from app-shell into `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (app-shell re-exports it), so the order and the placement cannot read an entry two ways.

**C — standing 「恢复默认顺序」.** `resolveRelatedArrangement` now reports `rearranged`: the shown order differs from the default, or a card is hidden. The column foot, which is the same line as 「已隐藏 N 张 · 显示」 and appears in both the related column and the tabbed tier's Related tab, then offers 「Restore default order」 (new key `detail.relatedRestoreDefaultOrder`, ten packs). It writes the new edit `restore-default-arrangement`: `order: []`, `hidden: []`, `basedOn` set to the current default's hash, `seen: {}`. Collapsed state is kept. The stored shape `{v,order,collapsed,hidden,basedOn,seen}` is unchanged. `RelatedDefaultChangedHint` is unchanged.

Not touched: `packages/spec/**`, `navigation-overlay.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`.

## Reverse verification

Each new pin was run against its mutation through \`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs\`. The tool's own verdict was \`ok mutation landed\` (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved), and it restored with \`git diff HEAD empty\` and the HEAD blob matching. All runs were vitest on the aliased \`src\`, so no dist step applies.

1. Related OFF keeps the rail (\`relatedRail: !columns.includes('related')\`): 7 failed (arrangement, \`RecordPageColumns\` and app-shell pins).
2. The header row drops the trailing segment: 10 failed (the components slot pin and the app-shell toggles file). The first attempt was refused by the tool as a no-op, because the replacement text already existed in the file. It was re-run with a distinct replacement.
3. The chord matcher reads \`code\` only: 1 failed (the code-less event pin).
4. Three-column floor back to 1280: 2 failed. The first run failed at import, with \`@objectstack/spec/data\` not found while the gate battery was running beside it. That run is not counted as a measurement, and the re-run is the reading.
5. Two-column floor back to 1024: 3 failed.
6. \`deriveRelatedLists\` drops \`relatedLists\`: 1 failed (the mounted order pin).
7. \`bodyTablePlacement\` places nothing: 5 failed.
8. The foot line never offers the restore: 2 failed.
9. \`restore-default-arrangement\` keeps \`hidden\`: 2 failed.
10. The pressed tint back to \`bg-muted\`: 1 failed.

\`git diff HEAD\` was empty after the ten runs.

## Gates

Derived with \`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack\` at \`9c82d929a8\`. The change set is 38 paths against merge base \`3bfb357aa3\`, which derives 34 commands. Each command's exit code was written before any pipe. \`--ran\` reports \`Run reconciliation — 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN\`.

33 commands exited 0. \`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/\` exited 1, with \`Test Files 2 failed | 167 passed | 2 skipped (171)\` and \`Tests 3 failed | 4898 passed\`. All three failures are known host gaps on this macOS box, the same three as in rounds 0 and 1 of #27310. Two are the bash 3.2 \`mapfile: command not found\` in \`select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts\`. The third is the \`check-i18n-dead-keys\` 「on the real tree」 case, which times out. These three are NOT MEASURED locally, and CI reads them.

**Declared narrowing — verification ran UNLOCKED.** `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`
could not take the shared verify lock on this host: no usable `flock`. The shared
verify lock is declared Linux-only (`flock` is util-linux, and a stock macOS does
not ship it), so every build and test command in this PR was run directly, without the lock —
a declared narrowing, not a silent one. No serialization guarantee held for these
runs, nor for any sibling agent in this container while they ran.

## Acceptance notes

- **`text-accent` vs `text-accent-foreground`.** The ruling names `bg-accent` + `text-accent` and describes the result as 「accent 浅底深字」. In both console themes, `text-accent` is the same pale HSL as `bg-accent` (light: `--accent` 240 18% 94%, measured on the page). The literal pair would draw invisible text. The on segment is therefore `bg-accent` + `text-accent-foreground`, which is the light-tint, dark-text pair the ruling describes. An off segment is `text-muted-foreground`. This is flagged for the seat in the report.
- **Wrapping on a narrow header.** At a 1024 px window (768 px record page) the header's actions plus the segmented control are wider than the header. The toolbar now wraps inside the header (`max-w-full`), and the segment ends its own line. Before this, the toolbar overflowed and a click scrolled the page sideways. `e2e/record-header-title-width.spec.ts` ran locally: 14 passed.
- **A group naming a side card.** Per the ruling, `bodyTablePlacement` places body tables only. A field group whose `relatedList` names a relationship that is not a body table (not `'primary'`, not an inline-edited `master_detail`) places nothing, and the card stays in the related column. Before this, such a group drew nothing either.
- `main` gained 7 commits since the base `3bfb357aa3`, none touching a changed path. GitHub reports no conflict, and no merge was made.
